activity.title: Activity

accounts.emptyHint: Accounts represent the entity you invoice (a company can have multiple).

newQuoteDialog.title: New quote
newQuoteDialog.description: Quotes inherit the opportunity context. Account is optional now but required to approve.
newQuoteDialog.categoryChooserDescription: Pick the type of proposal — this drives which workflow, fields and proposal blocks the quote will use.

project.title: Project Proposal
project.hint: Standard architectural project with stages, Gantt schedule, staged fees and the project fee calculator.

time_based.title: Time-based Proposal
time_based.hint: Hourly consultancy block — set hourly rate, hours per block and minimum commitment. Billed monthly against actual hours.

retainer.title: Construction Retainer
retainer.hint: Monthly retainer for the construction phase — start/end dates, monthly resources and reimbursable expenses. Billed monthly in advance.

newQuoteDialog.noAccountsHint: No accounts for this company yet. Create one in the Accounts tab.

confirm.send: Mark this quote as sent to the client?
confirm.approve: Mark this quote as approved? This will move the opportunity to Won.
confirm.approveNoAccount: No account is assigned to this quote. Approve anyway?
confirm.lost: Mark this quote as lost? This will move the opportunity to Lost.

dialog.sendDesc: Mark this quote as sent to the client? No email will be sent — this only updates the status.
dialog.approveDesc: Mark this quote as approved? This will move the opportunity to Won.
dialog.approveNoAccountDesc: No account is assigned to this quote. Approve anyway? This will still move the opportunity to Won.
dialog.lostDesc: Mark this quote as lost? This will move the opportunity to Lost.

convertDialog.title: Convert to project
convertDialog.description: Create the operational project from this quote? Stages, allocations and external services will be copied. This cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete quote
deleteDialog.description: This will permanently remove the quote and any associated planning data. This cannot be undone.

standard_project.label: Project Proposal
standard_project.hint: Stages, Gantt, resources, external services and the workplace proposal package. Use for fixed/staged design projects.

construction_retainer.label: Construction Retainer
construction_retainer.hint: Time-based support during construction, billed monthly in advance. Reimbursable expenses billed separately.

consultancy_hours_package.label: Consultancy Hours Package
consultancy_hours_package.hint: Block of hours for advisory / feasibility / due diligence. Minimum commitment upfront, remainder billed monthly on actuals.

feeCalculator.title: Architectural fee calculator
feeCalculator.subtitle: Estimate the architectural fee from the construction value, with corrections for foundations, heritage/refurbishment, extension and category.

publish.title: Preview & Publish
publish.description: Review the quote and use the existing workflow actions in the header to send, approve or convert it into an operational project.
publish.placeholderNote: Inline preview and publish are coming in a later phase. For now, use the proposal document generated from Step 2 and the header actions to drive the quote forward.
publish.headerActionsHint: Header actions (Send / Approve / Convert) remain the source of truth for status changes.
publish.softWarningHint: These are soft signals only — nothing is blocked.

estimate.label: Estimate
estimate.ok: Stages and allocations are in place.
estimate.todo: Add stages and allocations in Step 1.

payment.label: Payment schedule
payment.todo: Add scheduled payments in Step 1 → Payment.

overview.calculatorIntroHint: Calculate the base fee and distribute it across project phases. Status, account, proposal description and notes are managed elsewhere in the workflow.

timeBased.kindPickerHint: This quote is a standard project. Use the panel below if you also want to surface monthly retainer or hourly consultancy figures inside the generated proposal.

retainer.billingModeNote: Billed monthly in advance. First invoice issued at construction start; reimbursable expenses billed separately.
retainer.reimbursablePlaceholder: Notes on what is treated as reimbursable (travel, printing, permits, etc.)

consultancy.billingModeNote: Down payment invoiced upfront; remaining hours billed monthly based on actuals.

planning.allocPrereq: Add at least one stage and resource first.
planning.dragHelper: Drag resources into stages to build the fee.
planning.feeDriverHint: Your fee is driven by team time and external services.

warnings.noStages: No stages yet — add at least one stage to plan the work.
warnings.noTeam: No team assigned to this quote yet.
warnings.negativeProfit: This quote currently has a negative profit. Review fees, costs, or scope.
warnings.zeroProfit: Profit is zero — the quote covers cost but generates no margin.

financial.markupHint: Profit ÷ cost (how much you add on top of cost).
financial.marginHint: Profit ÷ fee (share of fee that is profit).

proposal.clientFacingHint: Client-facing summary. Internal cost, margin and per-allocation hours are hidden.
proposal.totalFeeHint: Inclusive of internal time and external services. Excludes VAT.
proposal.noStages: Scope of work to be defined.
proposal.acceptanceHint: By signing below, the client confirms acceptance of this proposal.

consultancy.sectionHint: Define the rate, hours block and minimum commitment. Leave blank to keep them open.

document.noBlocks: This document has no blocks yet.

renderers.consultancyFeeEmpty: Fee settings will be confirmed before Phase 1 begins.
renderers.consultancyPhasesEmpty: Phases will be defined upon engagement.

legacyPreview.title: Legacy proposal preview
legacyPreview.hint: Original auto-rendered preview. Kept for comparison until the block editor is complete.

intelligence.title: Proposal Intelligence
intelligence.subtitle: Suggested sections, phase narratives and clauses derived from the ontology. Insert what you need — everything stays editable.
intelligence.legacyHint: This proposal is using manual document mode.
intelligence.noDocumentHint: Generate a proposal draft first to enable insertions.

picker.label: Start from template (optional)
picker.blankDescription: Start with an empty quote and build it from scratch.
picker.empty: No templates available for this category yet.

saveAs.title: Save as template
saveAs.description: Snapshot this quote's stages, services, payment rules and proposal blocks into a reusable template. The current quote is not modified.
saveAs.preservationHint: Allocations are not included — templates capture structure, not specific resources.

list.title: Quote templates
list.description: Reusable templates for new quotes. Saved from the quote workspace.

empty.title: No templates yet
empty.hint: Open any quote and use 'Save as template' to create your first reusable template.

ontology.title: Planning bootstrap
ontology.subtitle: Generate stages, dependencies and payment defaults from a canonical preset. Your manual edits are never overwritten.
ontology.preserveManualHint: Manual rows are preserved on reapply.
ontology.generatedTooltip: Generated by the ontology bootstrap. Editing this stage marks it manual and protects it from future reapplies.
ontology.manualTooltip: This stage is managed manually and won't be overwritten when the preset is reapplied.

card.title: Contract
card.subtitle: Generate a sealed draft contract from this approved proposal. Later proposal edits won't mutate it.
card.onlyApproved: Available once the quote is approved.

detail.lockedIssued: This contract is issued and locked. Clauses and exhibits cannot be edited; regeneration is disabled.
detail.lockedSigned: This contract is signed and immutable. Create a new revision to change its terms.
detail.lockedSuperseded: This contract has been superseded by a newer revision.

actions.issueConfirm: Issue this contract? Once issued, clauses and exhibits become locked.
actions.signConfirm: Mark this contract as signed? It will become immutable.
actions.voidConfirm: Void this draft contract? It will be archived as void.

bootstrap.title: Project bootstrap
bootstrap.subtitle: Create the operational project from this signed contract. The project is sealed against the signed snapshot — later proposal edits will not affect it.
bootstrap.applyConfirm: Create the project from this signed contract? This action records an immutable bootstrap run.
bootstrap.alreadyBootstrapped: This contract has already been bootstrapped.
bootstrap.onlySigned: Only signed contracts can bootstrap a project.
